svg.title: Cradle assembly: recorded joint direction
svg.desc: Schematic, not to scale and not a fitted-build image. Two M4 bolts run from heads and washers in riser-back pockets through solid riser, an optional single shim and tray camera face to captive nuts in the tray screen face. A separate foot and T-bar reference uses two M4 by 16 bolts, washers and wing nuts. The T-bar meets a body-post pair through a shell opening, not a chassis slot; attachment hardware remains unknown.

g.text: SCHEMATIC · NOT TO SCALE · no fresh fit or pictured-build claim
Tray / riser joint: TWO M4 bolts + TWO washers + TWO captive M4 nuts
Bolt travel → repeat for both joint holes. Blocks show stack order, not part geometry.
Flat v26: M4×25 reference only. With shim: measure bolt length, engagement and phone clearance.
Recorded reference: TWO M4×16 bolts + TWO washers + TWO wing nuts.
Verify actual clearance and engagement; the tray/riser shim does not go at this foot joint.
T-BAR → BODY-POST PAIR, through a shell opening
Front or rear pair; NOT a chassis slot. Body-post attachment hardware/count remains unresolved.
Use the package instructions for phone insertion, retaining pin, orientations and fit checks.
